title: Demo - November route plan
body: The November 2-11 demo schedule is ready. Avery's crew covers the valley and New River stops; Riley and Taylor cover Moneta, Bedford, and Rocky Mount. All demo sites are ZIP-area map points, not customer addresses.

title: Demo - Supplies for fall cleanup
body: For the demo lake route, pack leaf bags, tarps, gloves, and drinking water. Add any missing items to the morning checklist.
